propositions: Provider-native auth capabilities must be injected into ProviderSession builders without forking the RP-01 authoritative path or altering Agent/request-budget/cache/output policy.
Rebar must construct, own, and close the sole official client; provider SDKs retain native auth precedence, refresh, expiry, and workload identity.
Auth capabilities must remain non-serializable and absent from LLMConfig, RunRequest, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, schemas, and public output.
Absent or conflicting explicit auth must fail before a provider model request, with no fallback to anonymous, alternate-principal, or cross-provider candidates.
One official client lifecycle and one ProviderSession per run must be structurally enforced; no bespoke runners, second clients, or alternate Agent/retry schedulers.
Live auth+cache canaries on Anthropic and Bedrock must pass without recording credential material or triggering fallback paths.
